hero.headline: Engineering the infrastructure that moves {money}, {scale}
hero.lede: I design event-driven payment systems for POS ecosystems — low-latency, fault-tolerant, and built to clear EMV L3 and PCI DSS scrutiny. Currently leading payment infrastructure at Wompi, inside the Bancolombia ecosystem.

about.eyebrow: About · the engineer behind the systems
about.title: Software engineer with one foot in the cloud and one in the silicon.
about.p1: M.Sc. in Software Engineering and a B.Sc. in Electronic Engineering — a combination I lean on whenever a system spans hardware (POS terminals, EMV kernels, Modbus-driven machinery) and cloud-native backends.
about.p2: Based in Colombia. Currently Tech Lead at Wompi, inside the Bancolombia ecosystem. Previously: banking integrations at Davivienda, cloud-native architecture at Datak, frontend and IoT telemetry at Erictel, and industrial automation at Inmetar.
about.p3: Outside of work — long walks, an espresso routine, and the occasional post about systems engineering.

status.ev2: EMV L3 cert run · processor-B passed

work.head: Seven years as a software engineer — two leading production payment infrastructure, one in enterprise banking integrations.
work.headMuted: Leadership and architecture in regulated environments where reliability is a contractual requirement, not an aspiration.

wompi.title: Tech Lead · Payment Infrastructure
wompi.lede: Lead the architecture of low-latency, event-driven payment infrastructure orchestrating real-time transaction flows across POS devices, payment processors and distributed backend services.
wompi.b1: High-throughput payment systems handling real-money transactions — idempotency, fault tolerance, transaction consistency, PCI/EMV compliance.
wompi.b2: Asynchronous workflows on AWS SQS and microservices: concurrency, retry strategies, transaction finalization and resiliency.
wompi.b3: End-to-end integrations with processors, EMV kernels, secure key management and payment hardware — including EMV L3 certifications.
wompi.b4: Defined organization-wide API and domain-model standards for external financial integrations.
wompi.b5: Mentored cross-functional squads, ran architecture reviews and drove technical decisions for mission-critical payment infrastructure.

datak.title: Architect & Tech Lead · Cloud-Native ERP
datak.lede: Designed a cloud-native architecture on GCP balancing performance, security and cost; led the cross-functional engineering team across backend and frontend.
datak.b1: Architectural decisions around App Engine, Cloud SQL, Cloud Storage, Firebase and REST API design.
datak.b2: Streamlined delivery workflows — measurable acceleration in feature throughput and quality.
datak.b3: Owned technical guidance for the engineering team and on-time delivery to clients.

erictel2.title: Frontend Software Architect
erictel2.lede: Led the architectural refactor of a field-workforce management platform serving the Brazilian telecommunications market — rewriting legacy views while keeping service continuity.
erictel2.b1: Coordinated with product, UX/UI and the client to migrate critical workflows without downtime.
erictel2.b2: Bridged a legacy Symfony / jQuery stack with a modern Vue 3 application via Webpack federation.

daviv.title: Tech Lead · Enterprise Banking Integrations
daviv.lede: Led a squad supervising external software factories and integrating their deliveries into the bank's cloud-native ecosystem on GCP. Worked across loyalty, insurance and rewards platforms.
daviv.b1: Integrated SOA-oriented services and legacy banking systems with modern microservice architectures.
daviv.b2: Operated cloud-native financial apps on Kubernetes inside a regulated banking environment.
daviv.b3: Aligned vendor deliveries with the bank's architectural, security and operational standards.

erictel1.title: Frontend Web Developer · IoT Telemetry
erictel1.lede: Built from scratch a real-time IoT vehicle-tracking platform — ingesting continuous telemetry from tracking devices and rendering high-frequency location updates without UI degradation.

inmetar.title: Full-stack Engineer · Industrial Automation
inmetar.lede: Edge-computing solutions bridging software with physical manufacturing — industrial PLCs, Modbus-driven servo machinery and a full-stack ERP ingesting data from the production floor.

exp.head: A working vocabulary for distributed systems, payment infrastructure and the operational realities of running them.

foot.colophon: Set in Geist and Geist Mono. Engineered as a static site. Last revision · 2026.05. Built for clarity, not for ceremony.
